sections.overview:
### Overview
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs

shadcn/ui is "a set of beautifully-designed, accessible components and a code distribution platform" — explicitly "not a component library" but "how you build your component library." TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Radix UI primitives. You install source code you own (via CLI/registry), not an npm black-box package.

### Principles (verbatim)
- **Open Code** — the top layer of component code is open for modification; you edit the button directly instead of wrapping/overriding.
- **Composition** — every component shares a common, composable interface, so APIs are predictable for teams and LLMs.
- **Distribution** — a flat-file schema + CLI distribute components across projects and frameworks.
- **Beautiful Defaults** — carefully chosen default styles, good out-of-the-box.
- **AI-Ready** — open code for LLMs to read, understand, and improve.

### Relation to DBUI
DBUI is built on this exact model — a shadcn-spec registry where you own the component source, reskinned with DuBois tokens. shadcn is DBUI's base.

### Known gaps
No design-language manifesto, brand guidelines, or look-and-feel philosophy beyond the five principles; visual opinion is deferred to the consuming app.
sections.colors:
### Colors
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming

Tokens are **CSS variables** defined in `:root` + `.dark` (dark mode overrides the same tokens under `.dark`). Default color space is **oklch**. Semantic **background/foreground pairs**: the base token is the surface color, the `-foreground` token is text/icon on that surface. Enabled via `tailwind.cssVariables: true` (the default); Tailwind maps tokens to `bg-*`, `text-*`, `border-*`, `ring-*`. Base color presets (`tailwind.baseColor`): **Neutral, Stone, Zinc, Mauve, Olive, Mist, Taupe**.

### Theme tokens (neutral default, real values)
| Token | Light (oklch) | Dark (oklch) | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| --background / --foreground | 1 0 0 / 0.145 0 0 | 0.145 0 0 / 0.985 0 0 | App surface + default text |
| --card / --card-foreground | 1 0 0 / 0.145 0 0 | 0.205 0 0 / 0.985 0 0 | Elevated surfaces |
| --popover / --popover-foreground | 1 0 0 / 0.145 0 0 | 0.205 0 0 / 0.985 0 0 | Floating surfaces (menus, overlays) |
| --primary / --primary-foreground | 0.205 0 0 / 0.985 0 0 | 0.922 0 0 / 0.205 0 0 | High-emphasis actions |
| --secondary / --secondary-foreground | 0.97 0 0 / 0.205 0 0 | 0.269 0 0 / 0.985 0 0 | Lower-emphasis fills |
| --muted / --muted-foreground | 0.97 0 0 / 0.556 0 0 | 0.269 0 0 / 0.708 0 0 | Subtle surfaces / helper text |
| --accent / --accent-foreground | 0.97 0 0 / 0.205 0 0 | 0.269 0 0 / 0.985 0 0 | Hover/focus/active surfaces |
| --destructive | 0.577 0.245 27.325 | 0.704 0.191 22.216 | Destructive / error |
| --border | 0.922 0 0 | 1 0 0 / 10% | Borders, separators |
| --input | 0.922 0 0 | 1 0 0 / 15% | Form control borders |
| --ring | 0.708 0 0 | 0.556 0 0 | Focus rings |

Plus `--chart-1..5` (see Data Visualization) and a full **sidebar** family: `--sidebar`, `--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-primary` (+ `-foreground`), `--sidebar-accent` (+ `-foreground`), `--sidebar-border`, `--sidebar-ring`.

### Not published
No default extended semantic palette (success / warning / info) — added manually via `:root`/`.dark` + `@theme inline` (docs show a `--warning` example).
sections.typography:
### Typography
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/typography

"We do not ship any typography styles by default." The Typography page is an *example* of styling text with Tailwind utility classes — e.g. `h1` = `text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight`, `p` = `leading-7`, `blockquote` = `border-l-2 pl-6 italic`, inline link = `text-primary underline underline-offset-4`. The type scale and font family are owned by the consuming app.

### Typeset — theme-aware prose/markdown
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/typeset

shadcn/typeset is a single CSS file that styles everything inside a `typeset` container. Condensed to three controls ("rhythm"):
- `--typeset-size` — base body text size (default `1em`)
- `--typeset-leading` — line-height (default `1.75`)
- `--typeset-flow` — space between blocks (default `1.25em`)

Fonts via `--typeset-font-body` / `-heading` / `-mono`. Container-aware sizing, follows theme tokens + dark mode, streaming-stable. Prior art: `@tailwindcss/typography` (`prose`).

### Not published
No prescribed type scale, font family, or weight ramp for app UI.
sections.layout:
### Layout
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs

Spacing uses Tailwind's native scale — there are no shadcn-specific spacing tokens. Ships app-scaffolding components: **Sidebar** (collapsible app layout backed by the `--sidebar*` token family), **Resizable** panels, **Scroll Area**, **Aspect Ratio**, and **Separator**. Under Tailwind v4, every primitive carries a `data-slot` attribute for targeted styling.

### Not published
No documented grid system, breakpoint tokens, or spacing scale beyond Tailwind defaults.
sections.depth:
### Elevation & Depth
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming

No elevation token scale is published. Separation is carried by the `--border` and `--ring` tokens and Tailwind's shadow utilities. `--card` / `--popover` surfaces are distinguished by color tokens, not a documented shadow ramp. The base layer applies `* { @apply border-border outline-ring/50 }` and `body { @apply bg-background text-foreground }`.

### Not published
No named shadow/elevation token scale (e.g. shadow-xs…shadow-xl) in the theme spec.
sections.shapes:
### Shapes
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming

A single base token `--radius` (default `0.625rem`) drives all corners. A derived scale keeps components consistent from one source of truth:

| Token | Formula |
|---|---|
| --radius-sm | calc(var(--radius) * 0.6) |
| --radius-md | calc(var(--radius) * 0.8) |
| --radius-lg | var(--radius) |
| --radius-xl | calc(var(--radius) * 1.4) |
| --radius-2xl | calc(var(--radius) * 1.8) |
| --radius-3xl | calc(var(--radius) * 2.2) |
| --radius-4xl | calc(var(--radius) * 2.6) |

Change `--radius` and the entire radius scale updates.
sections.iconography:
### Iconography
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/chart ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/tailwind-v4

Default icon set is **lucide-react** — a dependency, not authored by shadcn (upgraded alongside other deps: `pnpm up ... lucide-react`; used in chart config as `icon: Monitor`). Tailwind v4 recommends the `size-*` utility (e.g. `size-4`) for icon sizing.

### Known gaps
No governed semantic icon taxonomy or naming standard — icon meaning and selection are left to the consuming team (contrast: DBUI's `use:` icon categories).
sections.components:
### Components
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/tailwind-v4

~60+ components built on **Radix UI** behavior (keyboard/focus/ARIA come from the primitives). You install the source and own it. Tailwind v4 notes: `forwardRef` removed, every primitive has a `data-slot` attribute, `toast` deprecated in favor of `sonner`, and the `default` style deprecated in favor of `new-york` for new projects.

### Inventory (grouped, from the docs sidebar)
| Group | Components |
|---|---|
| Forms & input | Button, Button Group, Checkbox, Combobox, Field, Input, Input Group, Input OTP, Label, Native Select, Radio Group, Select, Slider, Switch, Textarea, Toggle, Toggle Group, Calendar, Date Picker |
| Layout & structure | Aspect Ratio, Card, Carousel, Collapsible, Item, Resizable, Scroll Area, Separator, Sidebar |
| Navigation | Breadcrumb, Menubar, Navigation Menu, Pagination, Tabs |
| Overlay | Alert Dialog, Command (palette), Context Menu, Dialog, Drawer, Dropdown Menu, Hover Card, Popover, Sheet, Tooltip |
| Feedback & status | Alert, Badge, Empty, Kbd, Progress, Skeleton, Sonner, Spinner, Toast (deprecated) |
| Data display | Accordion, Avatar, Data Table (TanStack Table), Table, Chart, Typography |
| AI / chat (@shadcn/react) | Attachment, Bubble, Marker, Message, Message Scroller |

### Not published
No formal per-component state matrix (hover/press/focus/disabled) in the docs; states derive from Radix behavior + Tailwind classes in the shipped source.
sections.dataviz:
### Data Visualization
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/chart

"A collection of chart components that you can copy and paste into your apps." Built on **Recharts** (v3) — deliberately **not wrapped**, so you follow Recharts' own upgrade path. Composition-first: bring in `ChartContainer` plus Recharts elements, then add `ChartTooltip` / `ChartTooltipContent` and `ChartLegend` / `ChartLegendContent` where needed. `ChartConfig` decouples labels/icons/colors from data; `accessibilityLayer` adds keyboard + screen-reader support.

### Palette tokens (real values)
| Token | Light (oklch) | Dark (oklch) |
|---|---|---|
| --chart-1 | 0.646 0.222 41.116 | 0.488 0.243 264.376 |
| --chart-2 | 0.6 0.118 184.704 | 0.696 0.17 162.48 |
| --chart-3 | 0.398 0.07 227.392 | 0.769 0.188 70.08 |
| --chart-4 | 0.828 0.189 84.429 | 0.627 0.265 303.9 |
| --chart-5 | 0.769 0.188 70.08 | 0.645 0.246 16.439 |

Config `color` accepts a single value or a `theme: { light, dark }` object. Chart types demonstrated: area, bar, line, pie, radar, radial.

### Not published
No prescriptive data-viz spec (chart-type-by-use-case, axis/label standards) beyond the component examples.
sections.content:
### Content: Voice & Tone
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs

### Not published
shadcn/ui publishes no voice, tone, or content/copy standard. It is code-first and leaves all product copy to the consuming app. (Contrast: DBUI's `brandvoice.md`.)
sections.accessibility:
### Accessibility
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/chart ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/tailwind-v4

Accessibility is inherited from **Radix UI** primitives — keyboard navigation, focus management, and ARIA are built into component behavior; the intro describes the components as "accessible." The `--ring` token drives focus outlines (`outline-ring/50` in the base layer). Charts expose `accessibilityLayer` for keyboard + screen-reader support. The March 12, 2025 changelog updated dark-mode colors "to be more accessible."

### Not published
No standalone accessibility standard, WCAG conformance statement, or audit doc; a11y guarantees ride on the underlying primitives.
sections.dosdonts:
### Do's and Don'ts
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/tailwind-v4

Guidance is expressed as principles and conventions, not a hard-rule block or shipped linter.
- **Do** use CSS variables for theming (`tailwind.cssVariables: true`, the default) and semantic `background`/`foreground` pairs.
- **Do** edit component code directly rather than wrapping or overriding (Open Code).
- **Do** derive corners from `--radius`; add new tokens via `:root`/`.dark` + `@theme inline`.
- **Don't** rely on `toast` (deprecated → `sonner`) or the `default` style (deprecated → `new-york`).
- **Tailwind v4:** prefer `size-*` over `w-*`/`h-*`; primitives use `data-slot` for styling.

### Not published
No shipped lint rules or an enforced do/don't checklist.
sections.agent:
### Agent Guidance
> Source: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/mcp ; https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry ; https://ui.shadcn.com/llms.txt

Strongest axis — first-party, agent-native distribution.
- **MCP server (first-party):** `npx shadcn@latest mcp init --client <cursor|claude|vscode|codex|opencode>`. Agents browse, search, and install components/blocks/templates by natural language across configured registries.
- **Registry spec:** flat-file schema with `registry.json` and `registry-item.json` JSON schemas (files, dependencies, CSS vars); install any item via `npx shadcn add <url>`. Supports private and namespaced (`@namespace`) registries with auth headers / env-var tokens.
- **llms.txt**, **Skills** for AI assistants, and **v0** integration.
- Principle "AI-Ready": open code for LLMs to read, understand, and improve.

### Relation to DBUI
DBUI already *is* a shadcn-spec registry — this is the distribution layer DBUI adopts wholesale (its step 9 reference).
